title: A share card from a selection
blurb: Select a passage and a canvas draws it as a share card: an HTML figure styled with CSS, drawn at 1200 × 630, 1080 × 1080 or 1080 × 1920 and saved, shared or copied as a PNG.
question: Can a card laid out by CSS be exported as a picture at a larger size than its layout, with the emphasis of the selected text kept?
result: Yes. The element is drawn again at the target size and the canvas is not tainted.
